manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed upward beside its velocity-time graph. Acceleration stays -g at the top while the force scales with mass.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The left scene shows the ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. The right graph shows v = u - g t with a marker at the current time.
